def lin(cols):

    v,_=lin([one,np.exp(th/T)]+E); out.append((v,'exp+',th))
    v,_=lin([one,np.exp(-th*T)]+E); out.append((v,'expT-',th))

import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    p = params
    a = p[0] + p[1]*T + p[2]/T + p[3]*np.log(T)
    b = p[4] + p[5]/T
    c = p[6] + p[7]/T
    return a + b*np.sqrt(eps) + c*eps + p[8]*eps**1.5 + p[9]*eps**2/T
